name.description: Name of the person or organization

nameType.description: Whether the author is a person (Personal) or an organization (Organizational), as DataCite nameType

Completeness.description: BUSCO completeness as counts, with the lineage dataset whose name gives its version (for example primates_odb10)

lineageDataset.description: BUSCO lineage dataset, including its version suffix

DerivationRelationship.description: Provisional relationship vocabulary for derivedFrom. Values and any PROV-O / Relation Ontology mapping await a maintainer decision (FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification#54).
DerivationRelationship.title: DerivationRelationship

DerivedFrom.description: Link to a parent file by its FHR-family checksum (specs/004-shared-core-schema FR-003). Provisional until the relationship vocabulary is decided (FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification#54).

checksum.description: FHR-family checksum of the parent file

headerType.description: FAIR-bioHeaders type of the parent file

relationship.description: How this file relates to the parent. Provisional vocabulary: a PROV-O or Relation Ontology mapping is pending a maintainer decision (FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification#54).

seqcol_id.description: Sequence collection digest of the parent, if supplied

DerivedFrom.title: DerivedFrom

allOf.description: Permitted FHT parent relationship: another FHT file filtered into this set, or an FHR genome whose bases were extracted (annotation-derived). Genome guidance alone is not a transcribedFrom link. The shared object already requires the parent checksum; accessionID is additional, not a substitute.

FHT.description: Metadata for a transcriptome FASTA file.

assemblyAuthor.description: Attributions for the assembly or extraction, when supplied

assemblySoftware.description: Software used to construct or extract the transcript set, with its real version and ordered options. Extraction is a process too.

assemblyType.description: Construction case for the whole described transcript set

checksum.description: Exact-file SHA-512/256 checksum under the shared exclusion rules

completeness.description: Optional BUSCO completeness counts from the actual run. lineageDataset must match the pinned shared pattern (a name ending in _odb plus digits, such as hymenoptera_odb10), so dotted dataset versions such as hymenoptera_odb12.2 are rejected. Do not rename a dotted lineage to pass the pattern; omit completeness and keep the measured lineage and counts in documentation until shared #170 decides dotted lineage support.

dateCreated.description: Date the transcriptome resource was created, not the sample collection date

derivedFrom.description: Reviewed FAIR-bioHeaders parent-file relationships only. This contract permits an FHT filteredFrom parent or an FHR transcribedFrom parent when the transcript bases were extracted from that genome; genome guidance alone never justifies transcribedFrom. Annotation coordinates and other sources stay in relatedLink/documentation until the shared relationship vocabulary is decided (#54). The shared DerivedFrom object requires the parent's FHR-family checksum; an accession alone is not a verified family link.

instrument.description: Legacy-compatible free-text sequencing instrument names. Prefer sequencingRuns when run accessions exist; do not infer an instrument from a run accession or a software name.

libraryStrategy.description: One supplied library strategy term for the whole set, using the producer's ENA term where applicable. Omit when experiments differ or the value is unknown; this slot is not an ENA-controlled enum.

metadataAuthor.description: Authors responsible for the header assertions

moleculeType.description: One producer-supported biological molecule class that applies to the whole described set. Omit for unknown or heterogeneous sets; total RNA and cDNA are preparation contexts, not uniform biological classes.

relatedLink.description: Related source, project, sample, experiment or protocol URLs

reuseConditions.description: Reuse conditions or license supplied for the transcriptome

sample.description: Supplied biological sample context. Repeat the object for pooled material; each item carries only the values actually known for that source. This is not a complete BioSample record and does not establish a uniform pooled identity.

schema.description: URL of the FHT JSON Schema this record follows (FHT-Specification raw main, a release tag URL, or its w3id URL). It identifies the header type and contract; it is not a transcriptome or project identifier.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the FHT schema contract ("MAJOR.MINOR")

scholarlyArticle.description: DOI of an article about the transcriptome

sequencingRuns.description: Actual SRA/ENA/DDBJ run accessions supporting the set. An SRS sample accession is not a run and must not be substituted.

strandedness.description: Supplied library strandedness under the FHT read/read-1 convention: forward means the single read or read 1 is sense relative to the originating transcript, reverse means antisense. Unknown or mixed protocols are omitted, never defaulted to unstranded.

taxon.description: Biological scope supplied by the producer

transcriptome.description: Name of the transcriptome resource described by the file

transcriptomeSynonym.description: Other supplied names for the transcriptome

vitalStats.description: Producer-reported measurements for the whole file. Counts describe FASTA records, including isoforms, not genes. Omit statistics that were not measured; a measured zero remains zero.

FHT.title: FHT

^x-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$.description: Extension field (FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification docs/FORMAT.md R15): any value; it means nothing to the standard

MoleculeType.title: MoleculeType

NameType.description: Kind of author, with the values of DataCite nameType
NameType.title: NameType

Sample.description: One supplied biological sample context. Pooled material is represented by repeated items, not by one fabricated uniform value.

condition.description: Supplied treatment, disease or other condition context

developmentalStage.description: Supplied developmental stage or life stage

tissue.description: Supplied tissue or anatomical source label

tissueIdentifier.description: CURIE for the supplied tissue concept, preferably UBERON, PO or CL. The pattern checks CURIE form, not that the identifier resolves.

Sample.title: Sample

Software.description: Software with its version and options.

commandLineOption.description: Command-line options given to the software, in order

Software.title: Software

Source.description: A source of sequences that is not a FAIR-bioHeaders file: a database release, set, annotation run or other contribution

assemblyAccession.description: Genome assembly accession that the source states for this set; an assertion by the source, not a checksum link

description.description: What was taken from the source, or how the sequences were contributed

name.description: Name of the database, resource or contribution

release.description: Release or annotation run of the source, as the source names it

sequenceCount.description: Number of sequences in the file that came from this source

setIdentifier.description: Identifier of the set taken from the source, for example a UniProt proteome ID

url.description: URL of the source or set

Source.title: Source

Strandedness.description: FHT library strandedness normalization (D3), not an ENA enum. It describes the library read/read-1 orientation, not genomic plus/minus orientation or the orientation of exported transcript sequences.
Strandedness.title: Strandedness

N50.description: Nucleotide length at which half the total sequence length is in records of that length or longer; computed from all sequence symbols

averageTranscriptLength.description: Mean number of sequence symbols per record, excluding deflines and line endings

totalTranscripts.description: Number of FASTA records, including isoforms
